name: governed-self-learning-readiness
repository_ready_when: durable conversation history is persisted and restored
every governed ACT path submits its outcome through one learning boundary
only externally evidenced, independently read-back success can create or reinforce a lesson
failed or unverified outcomes are kept as experience and lower rather than raise confidence
pattern identity, observations and evidence are derived by the runtime, never by the model
current runtime truth outranks learned memory and contradictions are recorded
repeated evidence can create a structured skill candidate
candidate approval and promotion remain separate explicit audited transitions
learned state survives a model or provider change
learning failure cannot rewrite successful action truth
production_ready_when: revision is deployed to the Debian production host
the production CLI can write and read the durable memory database
a real governed conversational ACT with independent external evidence produces a durable experience record
that outcome creates or reinforces an evidence-backed lesson
a separate process retrieves and reuses the same lesson
repeated evidenced success produces a skill candidate that stays CANDIDATE until an explicit approval
current_claim: repository implementation only; production learning evidence is claimed separately after host rollout, exact-revision readback and a live governed ACT
